## Où j'en suis
The staging RDS module now targets PostgreSQL 17.2 with blue/green update, and the AWS provider is pinned to `~> 5.82.0` (no v6). Three commits are in draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57. Only `terraform plan` has been run: staging shows 1 to add and 1 to change, and prod is prepared behind `pg17_enabled = false` with no changes. Nothing has been applied, and the database was only read through a single `select` on extensions.

- [en-cours] Draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 is open and awaiting review, with the pg_partman and dbt lock notes in its description.
- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman to 5.x on staging: `ALTER EXTENSION` on 16.4, then check `run_maintenance_proc()` on `events_raw` and `events_daily`.
- [prochaine-étape] Pick a production window that avoids the dbt lock on `events_daily` (01:00–03:30 UTC), after Maya signs off.
- [essai-raté] `terraform init` failed on the lock file. `init -upgrade` then selected aws v6.4.0, which produced 37 changes unrelated to RDS, so it was rejected.
- [question] Does pg_partman 4.7.4 really have to be upgraded to 5.x before the blue/green switchover? This is the agent's claim and has not been verified.
- [question] Maya's sign-off on the whole change is still pending.
- [décision] Pin the AWS provider to 5.82 and keep v6 out of this PR (source: t04).
- [décision] Only plan, no apply (source: t01).
- [décision] Keep prod disabled (source: t12).
- [décision] Record the pg_partman upgrade as a todo and run nothing against the database (source: t10).
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off; `apply_immediately` stays false (source: t14).
